You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From a2e8bbd2ef5457485f00b6b947bbbfa2778e5b1e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jun 2017 22:30:17 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] bpf: Fix test_obj_id.c for llvm 5.0

llvm 5.0 does not like the section name and the function name
to be the same:

clang -I. -I./include/uapi -I../../../include/uapi \
	-I../../../../samples/bpf/ \
	-Wno-compare-distinct-pointer-types \
	-O2 -target bpf -c \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c -o \
	linux/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.o
fatal error: error in backend: 'test_prog_id' label emitted multiple times to
assembly file
clang-5.0: error: clang frontend command failed with exit code 70 (use -v to
see invocation)
clang version 5.0.0 (trunk 304326) (llvm/trunk 304329)

This patch makes changes to the section name and the function name.

Fixes: 95b9afd3987f ("bpf: Test for bpf ID")
Reported-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@fb.com>
Reported-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin KaFai Lau <kafai@fb.com>
Acked-by: Daniel Borkmann <daniel@iogearbox.net>
Acked-by: Yonghong Song <yhs@fb.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
---
 tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
index d8723aaf827a..880d2963b472 100644
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/bpf/test_obj_id.c
@@ -23,8 +23,8 @@ struct bpf_map_def SEC("maps") test_map_id = {
 	.max_entries = 1,
 };
 
-SEC("test_prog_id")
-int test_prog_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
+SEC("test_obj_id_dummy")
+int test_obj_id(struct __sk_buff *skb)
 {
 	__u32 key = 0;
 	__u64 *value;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a naming conflict in the BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) code where the section name and the function name were the same. Specifically, both were named "test_prog_id," which led to a fatal error during compilation with LLVM 5.0, as it does not allow multiple labels with the same name in the assembly file. The patch resolves this issue by renaming the section to "test_obj_id_dummy" and the function to "test_obj_id," thus eliminating the conflict.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a naming conflict in the BPF (Berkeley Packet Filter) code where the section name and the function name were the same. Specifically, both were named "test_prog_id," which led to a fatal error during compilation with LLVM 5.0, as it does not allow multiple labels with the same name in the assembly file. The patch resolves this issue by renaming the section to "test_obj_id_dummy" and the function to "test_obj_id," thus eliminating the conflict.
